description: This donut chart, a variation of a pie chart, represents the distribution of "Stimulus Type," as indicated by the bolded text positioned in the center of the ring. The chart displays a total of ten distinct categories. There is no separate legend; instead, category labels and their corresponding exact percentages in parentheses are positioned outside the chart, directly adjacent to their respective slices. Moving clockwise from the top right, the segments are colored and labeled as follows: a red slice for "Draft/Other" (26.4%), a dark brown slice for "Event Posting" (6.6%), a mauve slice for "Organizational Report" (7.7%), a light purple slice for "Organizational Website" (4.9%), a dark blue slice for "Interview" (8.8%), a light blue slice for "Intra-agency news article" (4.9%), a dark green slice for "External News Article" (18.1%), a light green slice for "Email" (2.7%), a yellow-gold slice for "Press Release" (18.7%), and a thin orange slice for "Social Media Post" (1.1%). None of the slices are visually emphasized through explosion or offsetting, and the segments do not appear to be arranged in any specific ascending or descending order based on their size.
